name: agentflare
description: agentflare autopilot mod: guard, briefing, compaction, spawn, capture and idle work-pull for Claude Code.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: Pull the next work item when idle. 'once' pulls one item, then returns to off.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: Minutes of idleness before autopilot pulls work.

maxCostUsd.title: Max cost (USD)
maxCostUsd.description: Session cost ceiling above which autopilot will not pull work.

memoryCapture.title: Memory capture
memoryCapture.description: Whether learnings are captured to memory automatically, after asking, or never.

readOnlyAutoAllow.title: Auto-allow read-only tools
readOnlyAutoAllow.description: Let the guard allow read-only tool calls without a prompt.

guardTimeoutMs.title: Guard timeout (ms)
guardTimeoutMs.description: How long a guard check waits for the agentflare MCP server.
